QUESTION: Does giving PPO exact entity geometry (labeled teammate + enemy positions) recover 4v4 opponent-conditioned specialization, when nothing else about the recipe changes?
EVIDENCE_CHAIN_THIS_SPEC_RESTS_ON: TEST_0: o1=o2, q(t1)!=q(t2) constructively at N>=4, absent at N=2 (established, unmoved across every re-audit)
OBSERVATION_LADDER: defender counterexamples 9->0 at +TEAMMATES; enemy counterexamples 10->10 at +TEAMMATES, ->0 only at +TEAMMATES+ENEMIES
BC_REPRESENTATION_SMOKE: identical architecture (17,751 params) and split; val target-distance BASE=1.545 -> TEAMMATES=1.275 -> BOTH=1.170 cells, monotone exactly as the ladder predicts

CARRIER_RESTORE_TEST: the competing action-side hypothesis (carrier evasion) was tested and FALSIFIED -- removing the home override makes 4v4 GUARD catastrophically worse (V: 0.708->0.000). Action-side repair is parked; this spec touches observation only.

THE_INTERVENTION_is_extremely_narrow.changes: observation representation ONLY: add EntityResidualEncoder (rl/custom_ppo/entity_residual.py) computing g(teammates, enemies), added to the existing local_in = concat(cnn_features, vec) before latent_actor.
held_fixed: same 4v4 GUARD/BREACH regimes (pole A, pole B)
same action interface (macros, 50-waypoint vocabulary, commit horizons) -- carrier override UNTOUCHED
same training budget (steps) as the sealed B3-3 4v4 baseline
same evaluation protocol: paired percentile bootstrap, n_boot=20000, alpha=0.05, rng_seed=7
same architecture size where practical -- actor_cnn and latent_actor UNCHANGED, only new entity-encoder parameters added
same entity encoder design and weights-shape for both pi_A3 and pi_B3 specialists
fresh preallocated training/evaluation seed blocks, disjoint from all prior blocks
THE_INTERVENTION_is_extremely_narrow.why_so_narrow: changing observation and action semantics simultaneously would destroy the causal interpretation of the result. This run answers exactly one question.

ARCHITECTURE_CONTRACT.fusion_point: rl/custom_ppo/policy.py::_encode_local_obs -- local_in = local_in_base + g(T,E), verified by reading the code, not assumed
ARCHITECTURE_CONTRACT.guarantees_proven_by_test: tests/test_entity_residual.py, 10/10 passing against the REAL SharedActorCentralizedCritic (not a stand-in network)
ARCHITECTURE_CONTRACT.EMPTY_IDENTITY: g(empty,empty) == 0 EXACTLY for ANY weights (bias-free construction, not merely zero-init) -- verified across 5 independent random weight draws away from initialization
ARCHITECTURE_CONTRACT.PERMUTATION_INVARIANCE: shuffling teammate/enemy entity order leaves g unchanged, including under partial validity masks
ARCHITECTURE_CONTRACT.NO_MUTATION: local_in_base (the CNN/vec path) is bit-identical regardless of entity content; entities are additive, never a side channel into the base encoder
ARCHITECTURE_CONTRACT.WARM_START_EQUIVALENCE: at t=0, policy_logits on the augmented pathway are numerically identical to the base policy's logits even with real (non-empty) entity content present, because the final projection layer's WEIGHT is zero-initialised. This licenses literal warm-start from the sealed 4v4 baseline checkpoint with a PROVEN zero behavioural change at step 0.
ARCHITECTURE_CONTRACT.SCALE_INVARIANCE: shared per-entity encoders + mean pooling over a validity mask -- the identical module runs unchanged at 2v2/4v4/6v6, only K (entity count) differs. No architecture change is needed to port this to 6v6.

WARM_START_PLAN: pi_A3/pi_B3 initialise actor_cnn and latent_actor from the sealed B3-3 4v4 specialist checkpoints (CONFIRMATORY_B3_3_4V4_SPECIALIST_CROSSOVER_EVAL_RESULT.json lineage). EntityResidualEncoder is freshly initialised (zero-init projection). Verified by the WARM_START_EQUIVALENCE anchor: loaded behaviour is provably identical to the pre-repair specialist at step 0, so any divergence observed during training is attributable to the entity pathway learning, not to a discontinuity introduced by the architecture change itself.

SUCCESS_CRITERION_is_the_real_closed_loo.metric: LCB95(delta_A) > 0 AND LCB95(delta_B) > 0, identical protocol to every prior sealed crossover in this project

PRECOMMITTED_DECISION_TREE.next: freeze the 4v4 entity representation; port the EXACT SAME architecture (same encoder, same fusion point, same warm-start procedure) to 6v6. No redesign unless 6v6 produces new evidence of a further scaling issue.

PRECOMMITTED_DECISION_TREE.outcome: only ONE regime specializes (one delta's LCB95 > 0, the other's does not)
PRECOMMITTED_DECISION_TREE.next: diagnose the FAILED regime specifically -- do not redesign both. Check whether the failing regime's specific assignment pattern (e.g. more simultaneous threats) stresses the entity representation differently.

PRECOMMITTED_DECISION_TREE.outcome: NEITHER regime specializes, but training telemetry is healthy (stable losses, no NaNs, normal entropy decay, win rates in a competent contested band)
PRECOMMITTED_DECISION_TREE.reading: exact geometry was necessary for IMITABILITY (established by BC_REPRESENTATION_SMOKE) but INSUFFICIENT for PPO ACQUISITION
PRECOMMITTED_DECISION_TREE.next: this licenses the next rung: explicit r_i / role-assignment code, or an assignment-learning auxiliary signal. Do not skip to r_i without this outcome -- that would be changing the intervention after seeing a different failure.

PRECOMMITTED_DECISION_TREE.outcome: training itself is unstable or broken (NaNs, collapsed entropy, non-competent terminal win rates, divergence from the warm-started baseline behaviour beyond what the repair could plausibly cause)
PRECOMMITTED_DECISION_TREE.reading: infrastructure or optimisation problem, NOT evidence about the representation
PRECOMMITTED_DECISION_TREE.next: infrastructure/optimization audit. Do NOT interpret this as evidence against entity geometry. Re-run only after the audit clears.

WHAT_THIS_RUN_MAY_NOT_CLAIM: anything about 6v6 before it is separately tested with the same architecture
that r_i is unnecessary, if the outcome is anything other than full success
that the action interface is adequate -- CARRIER_RESTORE_TEST already showed it is complex and asymmetric; this run does not touch it
a sealed/confirmatory result until the crossover eval itself is sealed under Rule 7
